subject.title: fix(auth): expired OAuth credentials survive per-provider credential discovery and silently break background operations

question: Should background credential discovery intentionally adopt the same configured auth-profile ordering and live-versus-expired OAuth preference as profile-aware resolution for upgraded deployments?
rationale: The proposed repair changes an existing credential-selection outcome for users with multiple profiles; that compatibility behavior needs an owner-confirmed contract even though the implementation is coherent.

options.title: Adopt shared canonical ordering
options.body: Confirm that background and interactive paths should select the same configured and expiry-aware profile order, then resolve the remaining checks and merge.

options.title: Narrow the discovery policy
options.body: Retain a more limited discovery rule if background paths must preserve different selection semantics, with explicit tests documenting the intended divergence.

recommendation.title: Adopt shared canonical ordering
recommendation.body: Confirm that background and interactive paths should select the same configured and expiry-aware profile order, then resolve the remaining checks and merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to the PR and authored the branch changes that move discovery onto the canonical ordering contract.
